title: haworthiopsis × subrigida

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including the relief of pain, inflammation, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Haworthiopsis × subrigida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids. However, there is limited scientific research available on the plant's properties, and further studies are required to confirm its potential therapeutic effects and bioactive constituents.
